components.css: .ds-sheet{font-family:'Atkinson Hyperlegible Next Variable',system-ui,sans-serif;max-width:560px;background:#fff;color:#14213D;border-radius:4px;box-shadow:0 1px 1px rgba(20,33,61,0.06),0 6px 16px -6px rgba(20,33,61,0.14);}.ds-sheet-head{display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:12px;padding:12px 20px;border-bottom:1px solid #E5E9E3;}.ds-sheet-head h2{font-family:'Archivo Variable',sans-serif;font-stretch:72%;font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:0.04em;margin:0;font-size:15px;}.ds-sheet-head span{font-size:14px;color:#5E6880;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums lining-nums;}.ds-cols,.ds-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:7rem 1fr 4.5rem;gap:16px;padding:0 20px;}.ds-cols{font-family:'Archivo Variable',sans-serif;font-stretch:72%;font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:0.04em;font-size:12px;color:#5E6880;padding-top:16px;padding-bottom:8px;border-bottom:2px solid #14213D;}.ds-row{padding-top:16px;padding-bottom:16px;font-size:15px;}.ds-num{font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums lining-nums;}.ds-hl-row{position:relative;isolation:isolate;}.ds-hl-row::before{content:'';position:absolute;inset:4px -2px;z-index:-1;background:linear-gradient(98deg,rgba(227,242,76,0) 0%,#E3F24C 0.8%,#E3F24C 99.2%,rgba(227,242,76,0) 100%);border-radius:2px 8px 3px 10px;transform:rotate(-0.25deg);animation:ds-hl-swipe 640ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1);}@keyframes ds-hl-swipe{from{clip-path:inset(0 100% 0 0);}to{clip-path:inset(0 0 0 0);}}@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-hl-row::before{animation:none;}}

components.css: .ds-options{display:grid;gap:8px;max-width:420px;}.ds-option{font-family:'Atkinson Hyperlegible Next Variable',system-ui,sans-serif;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;width:100%;min-height:56px;padding:12px 16px;text-align:left;font-size:17px;line-height:1.375;color:#14213D;background:#fff;border:1px solid #D3D9D1;border-radius:5px;cursor:pointer;transition:border-color 150ms,background-color 150ms,scale 150ms;}@media (hover:hover){.ds-option:not(.is-chosen):hover{border-color:#5E6880;background:#F6F7F4;}}.ds-option:active{scale:0.99;}.ds-option:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #14213D;outline-offset:2px;box-shadow:0 0 0 5px #E3F24C;}.ds-option.is-chosen{border-color:#14213D;font-weight:600;}.ds-letter{font-family:'Archivo Variable',sans-serif;font-stretch:72%;font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:0.04em;flex-shrink:0;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;width:32px;height:32px;font-size:15px;border:1px solid rgba(94,104,128,0.6);border-radius:3px;color:#3D4A63;}.is-chosen .ds-letter{background:#14213D;border-color:#14213D;color:#fff;}.ds-hl-mark{position:relative;isolation:isolate;}.ds-hl-mark::before{content:'';position:absolute;inset:12% -6px 10% -6px;z-index:-1;background:linear-gradient(100deg,rgba(227,242,76,0) 0%,rgba(227,242,76,0.85) 1.5%,#E3F24C 6%,#E3F24C 94%,rgba(227,242,76,0.8) 98.5%,rgba(227,242,76,0) 100%);border-radius:3px 6px 4px 7px;transform:rotate(-0.6deg);animation:ds-hl-swipe-mark 520ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1);}@keyframes ds-hl-swipe-mark{from{clip-path:inset(0 100% 0 0);}to{clip-path:inset(0 0 0 0);}}@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-hl-mark::before{animation:none;}}

narrative.overview:
Every exam lives on a printed exam timetable, and your own row is the one swiped with highlighter. The shell is a felt-green board; the work happens on white printed sheets in navy-black ink. The system refuses the category's illustrated purple SaaS dashboard and the product's old near-black console: nothing glows, nothing floats in a void, nothing is decorated for its own sake. Information reads like a well-kept corridor notice: condensed caps for heads, a highly legible face for every sentence, tabular figures for every quantity.

State is printed, not coloured in. Status is a stamp cut from coloured paper stock that always carries its word. Correctness, event types and question formats use ink marks: a white stamp with an ink border, a filled ink box, a strike-through. Spent things are struck through, pending things are outlined with a dashed rule, chosen things are filled. The fluorescent highlighter is the one loud colour, and it only ever means "you, now".

Density is calm and generous on the student path (one question per phone screen, thumb-reach navigation, 44px minimum targets) and tighter on faculty and admin desks, where sheets carry tables of rows. Pins and tilt belong to the board's own notices (landing page, the student Rules notice, empty states); working sheets sit square.
keyCharacteristics: Felt-green board shell (CSS-only noise texture) over a pale paper ground.
White sheets with a small 4px corner and a real two-layer paper shadow.
Archivo condensed caps (wdth 68 to 72) for heads, stamps and column labels; Atkinson Hyperlegible Next for all reading.
Coloured paper stock as a fixed status vocabulary, always with a printed word.
Highlighter swipe (#E3F24C) reserved for you/now, visible by default, with a clip-path sweep played on top.
Tabular lining figures with units on every quantity.

rules.name: The You-Are-Here Rule
rules.body: Highlighter marks only the thing that belongs to the current user at this moment: your next exam row, current question, chosen option, own score. It is visible by default; the swipe animation plays on top of an already-visible mark and is removed under reduced motion. If a highlighted thing is not about "you, now", it is wrong.

rules.name: The Printed Word Rule
rules.body: Coloured stock inside a stamp, chip or row is the fixed status vocabulary (Upcoming, Open, Submitted, Flagged / Auto-submitted) and always carries its printed word. Never colour alone, never a new hue for a new meaning. A whole pinned notice may be cut from canary stock (the Rules notice, the login "Before you sign in" aside, empty states, landing claims); that is the board's notice paper and carries no status.

rules.name: The Ink Mark Rule
rules.body: Anything that is not a status (question type, audit access/admin events, correctness on review, formats) is an ink mark: a white stamp with a full ink border, an ink-filled box, or a strike-through. Do not borrow stock colours for it.

rules.name: The Tabular Quantity Rule
rules.body: Every quantity (times, dates, durations, counts, scores, violations, IPs) is set in tabular lining figures and carries its unit or noun: "30 min", "6 questions", "0/3 violations", "2 / 9". A bare number is unfinished.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Caps Archivo labels and heads; Atkinson reads. Never set a sentence in condensed caps, never set a head in the reading face.

rules.name: The Square Desk Rule
rules.body: Pins and tilt (0.6 to 2deg) appear only on the landing page, the student Rules notice and empty-state notices. Working sheets, forms, tables and the exam player are square and unpinned.

dos: Do reserve the highlighter (#E3F24C) for you/now: your next exam row, current question, chosen option, own score, focus.
Do keep the highlighter visible at rest and play the 520ms (rows 640ms) clip-path sweep on top of it; drop the sweep under prefers-reduced-motion.
Do pair every stock colour with its printed word, using only the fixed vocabulary: canary Upcoming, mint Open, sky Submitted, salmon Flagged / Auto-submitted.
Do use the MARK stamp (white, ink border), ink fills and strike-through for correctness, event types and formats.
Do set every quantity in tabular lining figures with its unit.
Do keep targets at 44px minimum and the phone question navigation in thumb reach.
Do guard hover styles behind real hover support (hoverOnlyWhenSupported).
Do use the shared Dialog for every modal so semantics, focus trap and Escape come for free.
donts: Don't use the highlighter as a hover colour, brand accent or decoration.
Don't invent a new stock colour or tone for a new meaning, and don't show status by colour alone.
Don't pin or tilt working sheets, forms, tables or the exam player; pins and tilt live on the landing page, the Rules notice and empty states.
Don't set sentences in condensed caps or headings in the reading face.
Don't use pure black shadows or glows; shadows are navy-tinted paper shadows.
Don't return to dark console surfaces or illustrated purple dashboard styling.
